gap_note: The combined gap score is a ranking heuristic, not a probability. Read the components (p_link, momentum, novelty, ...) next to it.
gap_rate_note: gap_rate_a/b: share of the concept's papers up to the snapshot year with an author-stated open problem (regex extraction, quality as in meta.open_problems); gap_rate = a + b. Display only: gap_score, the factors and the backtest do not use it.
label: Production forecast, not the held-out test. A model trained after the held-out test was scored: fit on origins [2010, 2011, 2012, 2013, 2014, 2017] and Platt-calibrated at [2020], which is the test origin, so its outcomes were used for training. This model was never itself held-out tested, and its probabilities are not shown to be better calibrated than the backtest model's. It ranks pairs that have not yet co-occurred 3+ times at the 2023 snapshot, the last year in this export. Their outcomes (2024 to 2026) are not observed, so nothing in this file was evaluated. The held-out result is in backtest.json and describes the backtest model, not this one.
